defect.summary: The session wrapper skipped its self-upgrade whenever its own process chain held any live workflow lease; on Capy that lease belongs to the machine's long-running server, so the upgrade was put off indefinitely.

severity.basis: The fix bounds the deferral by lease age and adds a regression test (test/capy-skill-wrapper.test.ts).
